rationale.zh: 已有研究在多种精神障碍中观察到显著性网络及相关连接的变化（P1–P3）。系统据此把问题缩小到右侧 ROI312：这个具体分区与显著性/腹侧注意网络的连接，是否在双相障碍和精神分裂症谱系中都降低？
rationale.en: Earlier studies reported changes in salience-network and related connectivity across psychiatric disorders (P1–P3). The system narrowed this question to right ROI312: is its connection to the salience/ventral attention network lower in both bipolar disorder and the schizophrenia spectrum?

feedback.zh: 系统此前测试过 ROI139 与同一网络的连接，两组虽然都呈下降方向，但重复抽样的一致性约为 51%。本轮改测 ROI312，并在模型角色讨论后修订了引用依据和对前序结果的解释。
feedback.en: The system previously tested ROI139 with the same network. Both groups showed a decrease, but the two directions agreed in only about 51% of resamples. This round tested ROI312 and revised the cited rationale and interpretation of the earlier result after discussion among model agents.

methods.zh: 使用 TCP 的静息态脑成像数据，计算右侧 ROI312 与显著性/腹侧注意网络的平均连接强度，分别比较两类患者与对照。分析考虑年龄、性别和扫描站点，再用 UCLA、COBRE 和 HCP-EP 的相应诊断数据检查方向是否一致，并考察头动的影响。
methods.en: Using resting-state brain imaging from TCP, the analysis measured mean connectivity between right ROI312 and the salience/ventral attention network and compared each patient group with controls. It accounted for age, sex and scanning site, then checked corresponding diagnostic groups in UCLA, COBRE and HCP-EP, including the influence of head motion.

results.zh: TCP 中两类患者的连接均较低，UCLA 也呈现相同方向；两组同时保持下降方向的重复抽样比例分别为 95.1% 和 99.3%。COBRE 和 HCP-EP 的精神病性障碍比较同样呈下降方向。
results.en: Connectivity was lower in both TCP patient groups, with the same direction in UCLA. Both groups retained the decrease in 95.1% and 99.3% of resamples, respectively. Psychosis comparisons in COBRE and HCP-EP also showed lower connectivity.

rationale.zh: 双相障碍的感觉运动连接研究，以及精神分裂症中的岛叶和视觉相关连接研究，为系统提供了相邻回路的线索（P1–P3）。系统进一步提出，左侧 ROI108 与感觉运动网络的联系可能是两类患者共同变化的一个具体位置。
rationale.en: Studies of sensorimotor connectivity in bipolar disorder and insular or visual-related connections in schizophrenia provided clues from related circuits (P1–P3). The system proposed left ROI108's connection to the sensorimotor network as a specific location that might change in both patient groups.

feedback.zh: 此前，系统发现两类患者的背侧注意—感觉运动网络连接均较低，重复抽样中两组同向的比例约为 96%。这次把网络层面的线索细化到尚未测试的左侧 ROI108。
feedback.en: An earlier experiment found lower dorsal attention–sensorimotor connectivity in both groups, with joint directional agreement in about 96% of resamples. The system refined that network-level clue to the previously untested left ROI108.

methods.zh: 从 TCP 的静息态脑成像中提取左侧 ROI108 与感觉运动网络的平均连接强度，比较双相障碍、精神分裂症谱系患者与对照的差异。考虑年龄、性别和站点后，在 UCLA、COBRE 和 HCP-EP 的相应人群中重复比较，并检查头动是否改变结果。
methods.en: Resting-state imaging from TCP provided the mean connectivity of left ROI108 with the sensorimotor network. The analysis compared bipolar and schizophrenia-spectrum groups with controls, accounting for age, sex and site, and repeated corresponding comparisons in UCLA, COBRE and HCP-EP while checking the influence of head motion.

results.zh: TCP 和 UCLA 中，两类患者均表现出较低连接，且两组同时下降的重复抽样比例都约为 99%。COBRE、HCP-EP 的精神病性障碍比较也呈下降方向，检查头动后方向未改变。
results.en: Both groups had lower connectivity in TCP and UCLA, with joint decreases in about 99% of resamples in each dataset. Psychosis comparisons in COBRE and HCP-EP agreed in direction, and the head-motion checks did not reverse the pattern.

rationale.zh: 系统综合了岛叶、视觉加工和感觉运动连接的研究（P1–P3），提出右侧感觉运动分区 ROI254 可能与显著性/腹侧注意网络共同受影响。已有双相障碍研究报告过不同连接一降一升，因此本次实验直接检验这个特定连接是否在两类患者中都降低。
rationale.en: Combining studies of insular, visual-processing and sensorimotor connections (P1–P3), the system proposed a shared change involving right sensorimotor parcel ROI254 and the salience/ventral attention network. Because earlier bipolar research reported decreases in some connections and increases in others, this experiment tested the direction of this particular connection in both groups.

feedback.zh: 前序实验在 ROI054 与显著性/腹侧注意网络之间观察到两组共同下降，重复抽样一致性约为 95%。系统沿着这条线索转测 ROI254，同时在讨论中补充了文献里方向不同的结果。
feedback.en: An earlier experiment found a joint decrease between ROI054 and the salience/ventral attention network, with about 95% directional agreement across resamples. The system followed this clue to ROI254 and incorporated the differently directed findings from the literature during its discussion.

methods.zh: 用 TCP 静息态脑成像测量右侧 ROI254 到显著性/腹侧注意网络的平均连接，分别比较两类患者与对照，并考虑年龄、性别及站点。随后用 UCLA、COBRE 和 HCP-EP 的相应诊断数据检查这一方向，另考察头动对比较的影响。
methods.en: TCP resting-state imaging was used to measure mean connectivity from right ROI254 to the salience/ventral attention network. Each patient group was compared with controls while accounting for age, sex and site. Corresponding diagnostic data from UCLA, COBRE and HCP-EP were then used to check the direction, together with head-motion analyses.

results.zh: 两类患者在 TCP 和 UCLA 中都呈连接下降，两组同向的重复抽样比例分别为 96.9% 和 98.6%。COBRE 与 HCP-EP 的精神病性障碍结果也沿同一方向，支持继续研究这条具体的跨网络连接。
results.en: Both patient groups showed lower connectivity in TCP and UCLA, with joint directional agreement in 96.9% and 98.6% of resamples. Psychosis results from COBRE and HCP-EP pointed in the same direction, supporting further study of this specific cross-network connection.

rationale.zh: 既往研究分别报告了注意相关连接降低、精神分裂症整体连接减弱，以及多种精神障碍中的网络变化（P1–P3）。系统将这些线索转成一个具体问题：左侧感觉运动分区 ROI036 与背侧注意网络的联系是否在两类患者中都较弱。
rationale.en: Earlier work reported reduced attention-related connectivity, lower overall connectivity in schizophrenia and network changes across psychiatric disorders (P1–P3). The system converted these clues into a specific question: is the link from left sensorimotor parcel ROI036 to the dorsal attention network weaker in both groups?

feedback.zh: 此前 ROI237 与背侧注意网络的连接在两组中均降低，重复抽样一致性约为 98%。本轮转向 ROI036；模型角色讨论还更正了该分区的归属，将问题明确为感觉运动系统与注意系统之间的联系。
feedback.en: Previously, ROI237's connection to the dorsal attention network was lower in both groups, with about 98% joint agreement across resamples. This round moved to ROI036. Discussion among model agents also corrected its network assignment, clarifying that the question concerns a sensorimotor–attention connection.

methods.zh: 在 TCP 中计算左侧 ROI036 与背侧注意网络的平均静息态连接，比较双相障碍及精神分裂症谱系患者与对照。模型考虑年龄、性别和站点，再在 UCLA、COBRE、HCP-EP 的对应诊断人群中重复比较，并检查头动因素。
methods.en: The experiment measured mean resting-state connectivity between left ROI036 and the dorsal attention network in TCP, comparing bipolar and schizophrenia-spectrum groups with controls. Models accounted for age, sex and site. Corresponding groups in UCLA, COBRE and HCP-EP provided further comparisons, including checks for head motion.

results.zh: TCP 和 UCLA 中的两类患者均呈连接下降，两组同向的重复抽样比例分别为 94.7% 和 96.4%。在另外两个队列的精神病性障碍比较中，也观察到相同方向。
results.en: Both groups showed lower connectivity in TCP and UCLA, with joint decreases in 94.7% and 96.4% of resamples, respectively. Psychosis comparisons in the other two cohorts also showed the same direction.

rationale.zh: 一项跨诊断研究发现，在某种动态连接状态下，双相障碍和精神分裂症等患者的感觉运动网络内部连接均降低（P1）。系统据此提出首轮假设：这种共同变化能否也体现在整个静息态扫描的网络平均连接上。
rationale.en: A transdiagnostic study found lower internal sensorimotor-network connectivity in a particular dynamic connectivity state across disorders including bipolar disorder and schizophrenia (P1). From this, the system proposed a first-round hypothesis: might the shared change also appear in mean network connectivity across the resting-state scan?

methods.zh: 利用 TCP 静息态脑成像，将感觉运动网络内各分区之间的连接汇总成一个平均指标，分别比较两类患者与对照，并考虑年龄、性别和站点。在 UCLA 复查两类诊断，在 COBRE 和 HCP-EP 进一步检查精神病性障碍，并考察头动影响。
methods.en: Using TCP resting-state imaging, connections among sensorimotor-network parcels were summarized as a mean measure. Each group was compared with controls while accounting for age, sex and site. UCLA provided both diagnostic comparisons, and COBRE and HCP-EP provided further psychosis checks, with head motion also examined.

results.zh: 感觉运动网络的平均内部连接在 TCP 和 UCLA 的两类患者中均较低，两组同向的重复抽样比例分别为 99.0% 和 97.1%。另外两个外部队列的精神病性障碍比较也呈下降，表明这一模式不只出现在单个局部分区。
results.en: Mean internal sensorimotor connectivity was lower in both groups in TCP and UCLA, with joint directional agreement in 99.0% and 97.1% of resamples. Psychosis comparisons in the other two external cohorts also showed decreases, extending the pattern beyond an individual parcel.

rationale.zh: 既往研究在精神分裂症中观察到视觉通路连接降低，也发现精神分裂症与精神病性双相障碍的视觉区域存在差异（P1、P2）；另一研究描述了精神病性障碍中的视觉网络组织变化（P3）。系统据此选择右侧 ROI201，检验两类诊断是否共享这处视觉连接的下降。
rationale.en: Earlier studies found reduced visual-pathway connectivity in schizophrenia and differences in visual regions between schizophrenia and psychotic bipolar disorder (P1, P2). Another study described altered visual-network organization in psychosis (P3). The system selected right ROI201 to test whether the two diagnostic groups share a decrease in this visual connection.

feedback.zh: 此前测试 ROI392 与视觉网络时，两组均呈下降，重复抽样一致性约为 78%。系统保留下降方向的假设，把测试位置换到视觉网络内的 ROI201，检查这一线索能否扩展到新的分区。
feedback.en: An earlier test of ROI392 with the visual network showed decreases in both groups, with about 78% agreement across resamples. The system retained the predicted decrease and moved the test to ROI201 within the visual network, examining whether the clue extended to another parcel.

methods.zh: 从 TCP 数据中提取右侧 ROI201 与其余视觉网络的平均静息态连接，比较两类患者与对照，并考虑年龄、性别及站点。随后在 UCLA 检查两组方向，在 COBRE 和 HCP-EP 检查精神病性障碍，同时考察头动是否影响结果。
methods.en: TCP data provided mean resting-state connectivity between right ROI201 and the rest of the visual network. Both patient groups were compared with controls while accounting for age, sex and site. UCLA was used to check both groups, and COBRE and HCP-EP to check psychosis, alongside analyses of head motion.

results.zh: TCP 与 UCLA 都观察到两组连接下降，但共同下降在重复抽样中的稳定程度分别为 82.6% 和 91.1%。COBRE 和 HCP-EP 的精神病性障碍比较也呈下降方向；整体结果与假设方向相符。
results.en: Both groups showed lower connectivity in TCP and UCLA, although joint decreases occurred in 82.6% and 91.1% of resamples, respectively. Psychosis comparisons in COBRE and HCP-EP also showed decreases. The overall direction agreed with the hypothesis.

rationale.zh: 跨诊断动态连接研究报告过视觉网络内部连接降低，另外两项研究提供了精神分裂症视觉加工和双相障碍视觉相关连接的线索（P1–P3）。系统在首轮将这些局部与网络层面的证据汇总，提出检验整个视觉网络平均连接的共同变化。
rationale.en: A transdiagnostic dynamic-connectivity study reported lower internal visual-network connectivity, while two other studies provided clues about visual processing in schizophrenia and visual-related connections in bipolar disorder (P1–P3). The system combined these regional and network-level findings in its first round to test shared changes in mean visual-network connectivity.

methods.zh: 把 TCP 静息态扫描中视觉网络各分区之间的连接取平均，比较双相障碍、精神分裂症谱系患者与对照，并考虑年龄、性别和站点。使用 UCLA 复查两类诊断，再用 COBRE、HCP-EP 检查精神病性障碍的结果，另做头动相关检查。
methods.en: Connections among visual-network parcels were averaged from TCP resting-state scans. Bipolar and schizophrenia-spectrum groups were compared with controls, accounting for age, sex and site. UCLA was used to check both diagnoses, with further psychosis comparisons in COBRE and HCP-EP and additional checks for head motion.

results.zh: TCP 和 UCLA 中，两类患者的视觉网络内部连接均较低，两组同向的重复抽样比例分别为 97.9% 和 93.0%。COBRE 与 HCP-EP 的精神病性障碍比较也呈下降，说明网络整体平均指标与本例预测一致。
results.en: Both groups had lower internal visual-network connectivity in TCP and UCLA, with joint decreases in 97.9% and 93.0% of resamples. Psychosis comparisons in COBRE and HCP-EP also showed decreases, matching the prediction at the level of the network-wide mean.

rationale.zh: 文献 P1 在多种精神障碍的一种动态连接状态中，观察到显著性网络内部连接下降。系统在首轮将其转成对整个静息态扫描的检验，并在模型角色讨论后，把诊断范围聚焦到双相障碍和精神分裂症谱系。
rationale.en: Study P1 observed lower internal salience-network connectivity in one dynamic connectivity state across psychiatric disorders. In its first round, the system translated this into a test over the full resting-state scan. Discussion among model agents focused the diagnostic scope on bipolar disorder and the schizophrenia spectrum.

methods.zh: 在 TCP 中计算显著性/腹侧注意网络的平均内部连接，比较两类患者与对照，并考虑年龄、性别和站点。用 UCLA 检查两组是否仍然同向，再在 COBRE 与 HCP-EP 的精神病性障碍人群中复查，同时考察头动影响。
methods.en: The experiment calculated mean internal connectivity of the salience/ventral attention network in TCP, comparing both groups with controls while accounting for age, sex and site. UCLA was used to check the joint direction, followed by psychosis comparisons in COBRE and HCP-EP and analyses of head motion.

results.zh: 两类患者在 TCP 和 UCLA 中均呈下降，但 UCLA 的共同下降稳定性较弱：两组同向的重复抽样比例为 89.3%，TCP 为 93.8%。COBRE 与 HCP-EP 的精神病性障碍比较也沿下降方向。
results.en: Both groups showed decreases in TCP and UCLA, but the joint decrease was less stable in UCLA: it appeared in 89.3% of resamples, compared with 93.8% in TCP. Psychosis comparisons in COBRE and HCP-EP also pointed downward.

rationale.zh: P1 报告了双相障碍和精神病性障碍中多个网络内部连接的下降。系统进一步追问：感觉运动网络与显著性/腹侧注意网络之间的联系，是否也会在这两类患者中共同降低？
rationale.en: P1 reported decreases within several networks in bipolar and psychotic disorders. The system asked a further question: might the connection between the sensorimotor and salience/ventral attention networks also be lower in these two groups?

feedback.zh: 前序实验曾同时测试 ADHD、双相障碍和精神分裂症谱系，三组都呈下降方向。本轮保留同一网络连接，聚焦后两类诊断；讨论后也删去与这一诊断组合衔接较弱的引用。
feedback.en: An earlier experiment tested ADHD, bipolar disorder and the schizophrenia spectrum together and found decreases in all three groups. This round retained the network connection but focused on the latter two diagnoses. Discussion also removed citations less closely connected to that diagnostic combination.

methods.zh: 从 TCP 静息态扫描中计算感觉运动网络与显著性/腹侧注意网络之间的平均连接，比较两类患者与对照，考虑年龄、性别和站点。随后在 UCLA 重复两类比较，在 COBRE 和 HCP-EP 检查精神病性障碍，并考察头动因素。
methods.en: TCP resting-state scans were used to calculate mean connectivity between the sensorimotor and salience/ventral attention networks. Both groups were compared with controls, accounting for age, sex and site. The comparisons were repeated in UCLA, with further psychosis checks in COBRE and HCP-EP and consideration of head motion.

results.zh: TCP 和 UCLA 均观察到两类患者连接较低，两组同向的重复抽样比例分别为 97.9% 和 91.5%。COBRE、HCP-EP 的精神病性障碍比较同样下降，UCLA 中共同下降的稳定性则相对较弱。
results.en: Both groups had lower connectivity in TCP and UCLA, with joint directional agreement in 97.9% and 91.5% of resamples. Psychosis comparisons in COBRE and HCP-EP also showed decreases, while the shared decrease was relatively less stable in UCLA.

rationale.zh: 默认网络研究发现，双相障碍和精神分裂症中都存在连接变化，其中既有降低，也有升高（P1–P4）。系统把问题具体化为右侧 ROI316 与默认网络之间的联系，检验两类患者是否共享下降方向。
rationale.en: Default-network research reported connectivity changes in bipolar disorder and schizophrenia, including both decreases and increases (P1–P4). The system focused on the connection between right ROI316 and the default network, testing whether both patient groups share a decrease.

feedback.zh: 此前，ROI297 与默认网络的连接在两组中都呈下降，重复抽样一致性约为 79%。本轮改测 ROI316，并通过模型角色讨论补充显著性网络与默认网络之间的相关研究，明确这是跨网络问题。
feedback.en: The earlier ROI297–default-network test showed decreases in both groups, with about 79% joint agreement across resamples. This round moved to ROI316 and added research on salience–default connections during model-agent discussion, clarifying the cross-network question.

methods.zh: 用 TCP 静息态脑成像计算右侧 ROI316 到默认网络的平均连接，比较两类患者与对照，并考虑年龄、性别和站点。UCLA 用于重复两组比较，COBRE 和 HCP-EP 用于进一步检查精神病性障碍，另考察头动因素。
methods.en: TCP resting-state imaging was used to calculate mean connectivity from right ROI316 to the default network. The two groups were compared with controls, accounting for age, sex and site. UCLA repeated both comparisons, COBRE and HCP-EP provided further psychosis checks, and head motion was also examined.

results.zh: TCP 与 UCLA 中的两组平均连接均较低，但共同下降并非十分稳定：两组同向的重复抽样比例分别为 89.1% 和 87.1%。COBRE、HCP-EP 的精神病性障碍结果则显示更一致的下降方向。
results.en: Mean connectivity was lower in both groups in TCP and UCLA, but the shared decrease was less stable: joint directional agreement was 89.1% and 87.1% across resamples. Psychosis results in COBRE and HCP-EP showed more consistent decreases.

rationale.zh: ADHD 儿童的平衡研究和早期精神病性障碍研究，都提供了运动相关或脑网络连接降低的线索（P1–P3）。系统将这些不同任务中的观察联系起来，提出检验左侧 ROI109 与感觉运动网络的共同变化。
rationale.en: A balance study in children with ADHD and studies of early psychosis provided clues about reduced motor-related or broader network connectivity (P1–P3). Linking these observations across settings, the system proposed testing a shared change between left ROI109 and the sensorimotor network.

feedback.zh: 系统此前测过 ADHD 与精神分裂症谱系中的显著性—感觉运动网络连接，两组共同下降在重复抽样中约占 97%。本轮把这个网络层面的线索缩小到左侧 ROI109。
feedback.en: The system had previously tested salience–sensorimotor connectivity in ADHD and the schizophrenia spectrum, finding joint decreases in about 97% of resamples. This round narrowed the network-level clue to left ROI109.

methods.zh: 在 TCP 中测量左侧 ROI109 与感觉运动网络的平均静息态连接，比较 ADHD、精神分裂症谱系患者与对照，考虑年龄、性别和站点。随后在 UCLA 检查两类诊断，并用 COBRE、HCP-EP 补充精神病性障碍比较，同时检查头动影响。
methods.en: The analysis measured mean resting-state connectivity between left ROI109 and the sensorimotor network in TCP, comparing ADHD and schizophrenia-spectrum groups with controls while accounting for age, sex and site. UCLA checked both diagnoses, and COBRE and HCP-EP added psychosis comparisons, alongside head-motion checks.

results.zh: TCP 和 UCLA 中两组都呈下降，两组同向的重复抽样比例分别为 95.9% 和 89.5%。外部 ADHD 组的变化比精神分裂症谱系组小；COBRE 和 HCP-EP 中的精神病性障碍比较也呈下降。
results.en: Both groups showed decreases in TCP and UCLA, with joint directional agreement in 95.9% and 89.5% of resamples. The external ADHD effect was smaller than the schizophrenia-spectrum effect. Psychosis comparisons in COBRE and HCP-EP also showed decreases.

rationale.zh: 文献分别报告了视觉网络、感觉运动网络及相关局部连接的降低（P1–P3）。系统将问题从各自网络内部推进到两个网络之间，询问视觉信息与动作系统的联系是否在双相障碍和精神分裂症谱系中都较弱。
rationale.en: The cited studies reported decreases in visual, sensorimotor and related regional connections (P1–P3). The system moved from changes within those systems to the link between them, asking whether visual–motor connectivity is weaker in both bipolar disorder and the schizophrenia spectrum.

feedback.zh: 前序实验中，视觉—感觉运动连接在 ADHD、双相障碍和精神分裂症谱系三组均呈下降。本轮沿用这一测量，聚焦双相障碍和精神分裂症谱系，检查这两类诊断的共同模式。
feedback.en: An earlier experiment found lower visual–sensorimotor connectivity in ADHD, bipolar disorder and the schizophrenia spectrum. This round retained the measure and focused on bipolar disorder and the schizophrenia spectrum to examine the pattern shared by those two groups.

methods.zh: 在 TCP 的静息态脑成像中，将视觉与感觉运动网络之间的连接汇总为平均强度，比较两类患者与对照，并考虑年龄、性别和站点。UCLA 复查两类诊断，COBRE、HCP-EP 补充精神病性障碍比较，另检查头动因素。
methods.en: Connections between visual and sensorimotor networks were averaged from TCP resting-state imaging. Both groups were compared with controls, accounting for age, sex and site. UCLA checked the two diagnoses, COBRE and HCP-EP added psychosis comparisons, and head motion was also examined.

results.zh: TCP 中两组共同下降较稳定，重复抽样比例为 97.3%；UCLA 中仍同向，但稳定性降至 87.9%，其中双相障碍组的变化较小。COBRE 与 HCP-EP 的精神病性障碍比较也呈下降方向。
results.en: The joint decrease was relatively stable in TCP, appearing in 97.3% of resamples. UCLA retained the direction but with lower joint agreement, at 87.9%, and a smaller bipolar effect. Psychosis comparisons in COBRE and HCP-EP also showed decreases.

rationale.zh: 小脑、眼动相关回路和程序性记忆研究提供了双相障碍及精神分裂症连接变化的线索（P1–P3）。系统进一步检验背侧注意网络与感觉运动网络之间的整体联系，而不是其中某一条局部回路。
rationale.en: Research on cerebellar, eye-movement and procedural-memory circuits provided clues about connectivity changes in bipolar disorder and schizophrenia (P1–P3). The system then tested the overall link between dorsal attention and sensorimotor networks rather than one local circuit.

feedback.zh: 前序实验在 ADHD、双相障碍和精神分裂症谱系中都观察到这两个网络连接下降。本轮没有加入新的前序实验，而是根据已有反馈，把研究对象缩小到双相障碍和精神分裂症谱系。
feedback.en: An earlier experiment observed lower connectivity between these networks in ADHD, bipolar disorder and the schizophrenia spectrum. Without an intervening experiment, this round used that feedback to narrow the diagnostic combination to bipolar disorder and the schizophrenia spectrum.

methods.zh: 利用 TCP 静息态脑成像，计算背侧注意网络与感觉运动网络的平均连接，分别比较两类患者与对照，并考虑年龄、性别和站点。再在 UCLA 复查两组，在 COBRE、HCP-EP 检查精神病性障碍，同时考察头动的影响。
methods.en: Using TCP resting-state imaging, the analysis calculated mean dorsal attention–sensorimotor connectivity and compared both groups with controls while accounting for age, sex and site. UCLA checked both groups, while COBRE and HCP-EP checked psychosis. Head motion was also examined.

results.zh: TCP 中两组同时下降的重复抽样比例为 97.1%，UCLA 中为 85.9%；外部双相障碍组的连接差异较小。COBRE、HCP-EP 的精神病性障碍结果仍沿下降方向，因此两类诊断的证据强度并不相同。
results.en: Joint decreases appeared in 97.1% of TCP resamples and 85.9% of UCLA resamples, with a smaller external bipolar difference. Psychosis results in COBRE and HCP-EP still pointed downward, so the evidence differed in strength between the two diagnoses.

rationale.zh: 既往研究将双相障碍的默认网络连接与认知表现联系起来，也报告了精神分裂症中相关局部连接及两类诊断的整体连接变化（P1–P3）。系统据此提出首轮问题：整个默认网络的平均内部连接是否在两类患者中都降低。
rationale.en: Earlier work linked default-network connectivity to cognition in bipolar disorder and reported related regional or global connectivity changes in schizophrenia and across both diagnoses (P1–P3). The system used these findings for a first-round question: is mean internal default-network connectivity lower in both groups?

methods.zh: 将 TCP 静息态扫描中默认网络各分区间的连接取平均，比较双相障碍、精神分裂症谱系患者与对照，并考虑年龄、性别和站点。在 UCLA 重复两组比较，再用 COBRE、HCP-EP 检查精神病性障碍，并考察头动影响。
methods.en: Connections among default-network parcels were averaged from TCP resting-state scans. Bipolar and schizophrenia-spectrum groups were compared with controls, accounting for age, sex and site. UCLA repeated both comparisons; COBRE and HCP-EP added psychosis checks, with head motion also examined.

results.zh: TCP 与 UCLA 中两类患者的平均连接都较低，但两组同时下降的重复抽样比例仅为 81.1% 和 80.9%。COBRE、HCP-EP 的精神病性障碍比较更稳定地呈下降；共同模式的稳定程度因队列而异。
results.en: Mean connectivity was lower in both groups in TCP and UCLA, but joint decreases appeared in only 81.1% and 80.9% of resamples. Psychosis comparisons in COBRE and HCP-EP showed more stable decreases, indicating variation in the consistency of the shared pattern across cohorts.

rationale.zh: 岛叶、感觉运动和视觉加工研究为系统提供了相关连接变化的线索（P1–P3）。系统将这些线索聚焦到图谱中的左侧额盖—岛叶分区 ROI098，询问它与感觉运动网络的联系是否在两类患者中都降低。
rationale.en: Studies of insular, sensorimotor and visual-processing connections provided clues about related connectivity changes (P1–P3). The system focused these clues on left frontal opercular–insular parcel ROI098, asking whether its connection to the sensorimotor network is lower in both groups.

feedback.zh: 系统此前观察到两类患者的显著性—视觉网络连接共同下降。本轮据此继续探索，既将起点细化为 ROI098，也将目标网络改为感觉运动网络，形成新的连接组合。
feedback.en: The system previously observed a shared decrease in salience–visual connectivity. This round continued that exploration by specifying ROI098 as the starting parcel and changing the target to the sensorimotor network, creating a new connection pairing.

methods.zh: 使用 TCP 静息态脑成像，计算左侧 ROI098 到感觉运动网络的平均连接，比较两类患者与对照，并考虑年龄、性别和站点。随后在 UCLA 检查两类诊断，在 COBRE、HCP-EP 检查精神病性障碍，同时考察头动影响。
methods.en: TCP resting-state imaging provided mean connectivity from left ROI098 to the sensorimotor network. Both groups were compared with controls, accounting for age, sex and site. UCLA checked the two diagnoses, while COBRE and HCP-EP checked psychosis, alongside head-motion analyses.

results.zh: 两类患者在 TCP 和 UCLA 中均呈下降，但 UCLA 的差异较小，两组同向的重复抽样比例为 80.4%，低于 TCP 的 90.4%。COBRE 与 HCP-EP 的精神病性障碍比较则更稳定地呈下降。
results.en: Both groups showed decreases in TCP and UCLA, but the UCLA differences were smaller. Joint decreases appeared in 80.4% of UCLA resamples versus 90.4% in TCP. Psychosis comparisons in COBRE and HCP-EP showed more stable decreases.

rationale.zh: ADHD 的运动控制研究和精神分裂症连接研究，都提供了局部连接降低的线索（P1、P2）。系统把这些线索扩展为边缘网络与感觉运动网络之间的共同下降假设；这两项文献并未直接测试这一整组网络连接。
rationale.en: Motor-control research in ADHD and connectivity research in schizophrenia provided clues about lower regional connectivity (P1, P2). The system extended these to a hypothesis of shared reduction between limbic and sensorimotor networks; neither cited study directly tested this complete network pairing.

feedback.zh: 此前，同一网络连接在双相障碍和精神分裂症谱系中都呈下降。本轮保留测量，改为比较 ADHD 与精神分裂症谱系，并在模型角色讨论后精简了引用依据。
feedback.en: Previously, the same network connection showed decreases in bipolar disorder and the schizophrenia spectrum. This round retained the measure but changed the diagnostic pairing to ADHD and the schizophrenia spectrum, refining the citations after model-agent discussion.

methods.zh: 在 TCP 中计算边缘网络与感觉运动网络的平均静息态连接，比较 ADHD、精神分裂症谱系患者与对照，并考虑年龄、性别和站点。UCLA 用于复查两组，COBRE、HCP-EP 补充精神病性障碍比较，另检查头动因素。
methods.en: The experiment calculated mean resting-state connectivity between limbic and sensorimotor networks in TCP, comparing ADHD and schizophrenia-spectrum groups with controls while accounting for age, sex and site. UCLA checked both groups; COBRE and HCP-EP added psychosis comparisons, with head motion also examined.

results.zh: TCP 中两组都呈下降，但 UCLA 的 ADHD 组差异接近于零，两组同时下降的重复抽样比例仅为 52.3%。COBRE 和 HCP-EP 仍观察到精神病性障碍连接降低，因此外部结果未形成稳定的两诊断共同模式。
results.en: Both groups showed decreases in TCP, but the UCLA ADHD difference was close to zero. Joint decreases appeared in only 52.3% of UCLA resamples. COBRE and HCP-EP still showed lower psychosis connectivity, so the external results did not establish a stable pattern shared by both diagnoses.

rationale.zh: 系统参考了 ADHD 共病研究、跨诊断连接偏离研究和早期精神病性障碍的网络研究（P1–P4），将注意与视觉处理之间的联系作为测试对象。它提出三类诊断都可能出现下降，但文献尚未直接给出这两个网络的共同方向。
rationale.en: The system drew on ADHD-comorbidity research, studies of transdiagnostic connectivity deviations and network research in early psychosis (P1–P4). It selected the attention–visual connection for testing and proposed a decrease across three diagnoses, although the literature had not directly established a shared direction for this network pair.

feedback.zh: 前序实验在三类诊断中观察到感觉运动—视觉网络连接下降。本轮保留三类诊断和视觉网络，把另一端改为背侧注意网络，检查相邻研究问题是否也呈同样方向。
feedback.en: The earlier experiment observed lower sensorimotor–visual connectivity across three diagnoses. This round kept the diagnoses and visual network but changed the other network to dorsal attention, testing whether the related question would show the same direction.

methods.zh: 在 TCP 静息态脑成像中测量背侧注意—视觉网络的平均连接，分别比较 ADHD、双相障碍和精神分裂症谱系患者与对照，考虑年龄、性别和站点。UCLA 复查三组，COBRE、HCP-EP 补充精神病性障碍比较，并考察头动影响。
methods.en: The analysis measured mean dorsal attention–visual connectivity in TCP resting-state imaging. ADHD, bipolar and schizophrenia-spectrum groups were compared separately with controls, accounting for age, sex and site. UCLA checked all three groups; COBRE and HCP-EP added psychosis comparisons, alongside head-motion checks.

results.zh: TCP 中三组都呈下降，但 UCLA 中 ADHD 的差异很小，三组同时下降的重复抽样比例从 TCP 的 88.3% 降到 52.0%。另外两个队列的精神病性障碍结果仍呈下降，三诊断共享模式没有得到同样稳定的外部支持。
results.en: All three groups showed decreases in TCP, but the UCLA ADHD difference was small. Joint decreases across all three fell from 88.3% of TCP resamples to 52.0% in UCLA. Psychosis results in the other two cohorts still showed decreases, but external support for a shared three-diagnosis pattern was less stable.

rationale.zh: ADHD 的认知控制和平衡研究提示部分连接降低，双相障碍研究则提供了感觉运动连接与执行功能的线索（P1–P3）。系统据此选择左侧 ROI104 到感觉运动网络的联系，检验这两类诊断能否呈现共同变化。
rationale.en: ADHD studies of cognitive control and balance suggested reduced connectivity in some circuits, while bipolar research linked sensorimotor connectivity with executive function (P1–P3). The system selected the connection from left ROI104 to the sensorimotor network to test for a shared change across these diagnoses.

feedback.zh: 此前，ADHD 与双相障碍的背侧注意—感觉运动连接均较低，重复抽样中两组同向的比例约为 92%。本轮把网络层面的测试细化到左侧 ROI104。
feedback.en: An earlier experiment found lower dorsal attention–sensorimotor connectivity in ADHD and bipolar disorder, with joint decreases in about 92% of resamples. This round refined the network-level test to left ROI104.

methods.zh: 从 TCP 静息态脑成像中提取左侧 ROI104 与感觉运动网络的平均连接，比较 ADHD、双相障碍患者与对照，考虑年龄、性别和站点。随后在 UCLA 的这两类诊断中重复分析，并检查头动对结果的影响。
methods.en: TCP resting-state imaging provided mean connectivity between left ROI104 and the sensorimotor network. ADHD and bipolar groups were compared with controls, accounting for age, sex and site. The analysis was repeated for these diagnoses in UCLA, including a check of head-motion effects.

results.zh: TCP 中两组均呈下降；在 UCLA 中，双相障碍仍呈下降，但 ADHD 与对照几乎没有差异。外部两组同时下降的重复抽样比例为 49.5%，因此共同下降未得到稳定复现。
results.en: Both groups showed decreases in TCP. In UCLA, the bipolar group retained a decrease, but ADHD differed little from controls. Joint decreases appeared in 49.5% of external resamples, so the shared pattern was not stably reproduced.

rationale.zh: 视觉网络研究报告了跨诊断连接降低，双相障碍研究也描述了杏仁核与视觉网络之间的变化（P1–P3）。系统将这些线索延伸到视觉网络与边缘网络的整体联系，检验两类患者是否共同下降。
rationale.en: Visual-network research reported transdiagnostic connectivity reductions, while bipolar research described changes between amygdala subregions and the visual network (P1–P3). The system extended these clues to the overall visual–limbic connection, testing a shared decrease in both groups.

feedback.zh: 前序实验测的是三类诊断的视觉网络内部连接，并观察到共同下降。本轮将测试从视觉网络内部移到视觉—边缘网络之间，同时聚焦双相障碍和精神分裂症谱系。
feedback.en: The earlier experiment measured internal visual-network connectivity across three diagnoses and found joint decreases. This round moved from within-network connectivity to the visual–limbic connection and focused on bipolar disorder and the schizophrenia spectrum.

methods.zh: 用 TCP 静息态脑成像计算视觉网络与边缘网络的平均连接，比较两类患者与对照，并考虑年龄、性别和站点。UCLA 用于复查两类诊断，COBRE、HCP-EP 用于补充精神病性障碍比较，另考察头动影响。
methods.en: TCP resting-state imaging was used to calculate mean visual–limbic connectivity. Both patient groups were compared with controls, accounting for age, sex and site. UCLA checked both diagnoses, COBRE and HCP-EP added psychosis comparisons, and head motion was also examined.

results.zh: TCP 中两组均呈下降，但 UCLA 的两组差异都较小，共同下降的重复抽样比例仅为 45.9%。COBRE 与 HCP-EP 的精神病性障碍结果仍呈下降，整体外部表现与稳定的两诊断共享模式不一致。
results.en: Both groups showed decreases in TCP, but both UCLA differences were small, with joint decreases in only 45.9% of resamples. Psychosis results in COBRE and HCP-EP still pointed downward, but the overall external pattern did not support a stable effect shared by both diagnoses.

rationale.zh: 已有研究发现，较高的阿尔茨海默病多基因风险与较小的海马有关（P1）。系统据此提出，用 ADNI 的遗传评分与基线 MRI 数据，检查这一关系能否在另一批参与者中观察到。
rationale.en: Earlier research linked higher Alzheimer's disease polygenic risk to smaller hippocampi (P1). The system therefore proposed using ADNI genetic scores and baseline MRI to examine the relationship in another group of participants.

methods.zh: 先在 ADNI1/GO/2 中比较不同遗传风险评分对应的海马大小，再用 ADNI3 重复分析。海马体积按头颅大小调整，模型考虑年龄、性别、教育、遗传背景和站点，并用不同关联分析检查结果是否一致。
methods.en: The analysis first compared hippocampal size across genetic-risk scores in ADNI1/GO/2, then repeated the analysis in ADNI3. Hippocampal volume was adjusted for head size. Models accounted for age, sex, education, genetic background and site, with different association approaches used to check consistency.

results.zh: 内部分析仅呈较弱的负向关联，外部线性分析则略偏正向，相关系数分别为 −0.094 和 0.046。两批数据的各类分析均未达到校正后的统计标准，因此本次未支持“评分越高、海马越小”的假设。
results.en: The internal association was weakly negative, whereas the external linear association was slightly positive, with correlations of −0.094 and 0.046. None of the approaches in either dataset met the corrected statistical criterion, so this experiment did not support the proposed higher-score–smaller-hippocampus relationship.

rationale.zh: 已有随访研究发现，APOE ε4 携带者在进展至痴呆后，内嗅皮层萎缩较快（P1）。系统把“随时间变化更快”的线索转成一个基线问题：ε4 拷贝数更多的人，内嗅皮层是否也较小？
rationale.en: A previous follow-up study found faster entorhinal atrophy in APOE ε4 carriers after progression to dementia (P1). The system translated that longitudinal clue into a baseline question: do people with more ε4 copies also have smaller entorhinal cortices?

methods.zh: 用 ADNI1/GO/2 的基因型与结构 MRI，比较 APOE ε4 拷贝数与内嗅皮层体积，并在 ADNI3 检查同一关系。体积按头颅大小调整，分析考虑年龄、性别、教育、遗传背景和站点，并比较不同统计方法的结果。
methods.en: Genotype and structural MRI data from ADNI1/GO/2 were used to relate APOE ε4 copy number to entorhinal volume, followed by the same analysis in ADNI3. Volume was adjusted for head size, and models accounted for age, sex, education, genetic background and site. Different statistical approaches were compared.

results.zh: ε4 拷贝数更多与较小内嗅皮层相关，内部和外部线性分析的相关系数分别为 −0.141、−0.158，均通过校正后的统计标准。稳健回归也支持同一方向；秩关联只在外部分析中达到该标准。
results.en: More ε4 copies were associated with smaller entorhinal volume. Linear correlations were −0.141 internally and −0.158 externally, both meeting the corrected statistical criterion. Robust regression supported the same direction, while rank-based association met the criterion only in the external analysis.

rationale.zh: 既有队列研究观察到，携带两个 APOE ε4 拷贝的人海马较小（P1）。系统进一步按 0、1、2 个拷贝检验剂量关系，询问拷贝数增加是否对应海马体积的连续变化。
rationale.en: An earlier cohort study observed smaller hippocampi in people with two APOE ε4 copies (P1). The system extended this to a dosage test across zero, one and two copies, asking whether increasing copy number corresponds to a graded difference in hippocampal volume.

methods.zh: 将 ADNI1/GO/2 的 APOE ε4 拷贝数与基线海马 MRI 体积进行关联分析，再在 ADNI3 中重复检验。模型考虑头颅大小、年龄、性别、教育、遗传背景和站点，并用秩关联及稳健回归检查不同分析方法是否得到相似结果。
methods.en: The analysis related APOE ε4 copy number to baseline hippocampal MRI volume in ADNI1/GO/2, then repeated the test in ADNI3. It accounted for head size, age, sex, education, genetic background and site, with rank-based association and robust regression used to check agreement across approaches.

results.zh: 内部与外部线性分析均发现 ε4 拷贝数更多对应海马较小，相关系数分别为 −0.185 和 −0.160，且都通过校正后的统计标准。稳健回归结果一致；外部秩关联仍为负向，但未达到同一标准。
results.en: Internal and external linear analyses both linked more ε4 copies to smaller hippocampi, with correlations of −0.185 and −0.160, each meeting the corrected statistical criterion. Robust regression agreed. The external rank-based association remained negative but did not meet that criterion.

rationale.zh: APOE ε4 与较快颞中回萎缩的既有观察（P1），使系统把关注点从海马扩展到外侧颞叶。本次检验的是基线体积：ε4 拷贝数较多的人，颞中回是否也较小。
rationale.en: An earlier observation linking APOE ε4 to faster middle temporal atrophy (P1) prompted the system to extend its focus beyond the hippocampus to lateral temporal cortex. This experiment concerned baseline size: do people with more ε4 copies have smaller middle temporal gyri?

methods.zh: 利用 ADNI1/GO/2 的基因型和结构 MRI，检验 ε4 拷贝数与颞中回体积的关系，再用 ADNI3 复查。分析考虑头颅大小及人口学、遗传背景和站点差异，并比较线性、秩关联与稳健回归三种结果。
methods.en: Genotype and structural MRI from ADNI1/GO/2 were used to test the relationship between ε4 copy number and middle temporal volume, followed by an ADNI3 check. The analysis accounted for head size, demographic factors, genetic background and site, comparing linear, rank-based and robust approaches.

results.zh: 两批数据的表现不同：内部线性关联接近于零（r = −0.034），外部则为较明确的负向关联（r = −0.199）。内部三种分析均未通过校正后的统计标准，外部三种均通过；因此支持主要来自外部队列。
results.en: The datasets differed: the internal linear association was close to zero (r = −0.034), while the external association was more clearly negative (r = −0.199). None of the three internal approaches met the corrected statistical criterion, whereas all three external approaches did. Support therefore came primarily from the external cohort.

rationale.zh: 此前研究发现 APOE ε4 携带者的脑室扩大速度更快（P1）。系统据此检验一个相关但不同的问题：在同一基线时间点，ε4 拷贝数是否与脑室大小有关。
rationale.en: Previous research found faster ventricular enlargement in APOE ε4 carriers (P1). The system used this to test a related but different question: is ε4 copy number associated with ventricular size at baseline?

methods.zh: 在 ADNI1/GO/2 中关联 ε4 拷贝数与基线脑室体积，并在 ADNI3 重复分析。体积按头颅大小调整，模型考虑年龄、性别、教育、遗传背景和站点，同时检查不同关联方法是否一致。
methods.en: The experiment related ε4 copy number to baseline ventricular volume in ADNI1/GO/2 and repeated the analysis in ADNI3. Volume was adjusted for head size. Models accounted for age, sex, education, genetic background and site, with different association methods checked for consistency.

results.zh: 内部和外部线性关联都接近于零，相关系数分别为 −0.023 和 −0.040。其他统计方法也未得到通过校正标准的关联；本次基线分析没有支持 ε4 拷贝数与脑室大小存在明确关系。
results.en: Both internal and external linear associations were close to zero, with correlations of −0.023 and −0.040. The other approaches also found no association meeting the corrected criterion. This baseline analysis did not support a clear relationship between ε4 copy number and ventricular size.

rationale.zh: 既有影像遗传学研究将多基因评分与海马体积联系起来（P1）。系统将这一思路收窄到 AD 风险 GWAS 涉及的基因集合，检验这组基因形成的评分是否也对应海马大小。
rationale.en: Earlier imaging-genetics research linked polygenic scores with hippocampal volume (P1). The system narrowed this idea to a gene set implicated by AD-risk GWAS, testing whether a score derived from that set also relates to hippocampal size.

methods.zh: 利用 ADNI1/GO/2 的基因集评分与海马 MRI 体积做关联分析，再用 ADNI3 检查结果。分析考虑头颅大小、人口学因素、遗传背景及站点，并用不同统计方法比较关联方向和强度。
methods.en: The gene-set score was related to hippocampal MRI volume in ADNI1/GO/2, followed by a check in ADNI3. Analyses accounted for head size, demographic factors, genetic background and site, using different statistical approaches to compare association direction and strength.

results.zh: 内部线性关联很弱（r = −0.016），外部负向趋势较大（r = −0.117），但两批数据均未通过校正后的统计标准。外部秩关联和稳健回归也只是接近标准，尚未形成明确的跨队列支持。
results.en: The internal linear association was weak (r = −0.016), and the external negative trend was larger (r = −0.117), but neither met the corrected statistical criterion. External rank-based and robust analyses approached, but did not meet, that criterion, leaving no clear cross-cohort support.

rationale.zh: 文献 P1 报告较高的 AD 多基因风险与较小海马及后续认知下降有关。系统进一步选择孟德尔型 AD 相关基因集合，检验这组评分是否能够对应海马体积差异。
rationale.en: P1 linked higher AD polygenic risk to smaller hippocampi and subsequent cognitive decline. The system selected a Mendelian-AD-related gene set for a further test of whether its aggregate score corresponds to hippocampal-volume differences.

methods.zh: 将 ADNI1/GO/2 的孟德尔型 AD 基因集评分与基线海马体积进行关联，并在 ADNI3 中重复检验。模型考虑头颅大小、人口学因素、遗传背景和站点，用三类关联分析检查结果的一致性。
methods.en: The Mendelian-AD gene-set score was related to baseline hippocampal volume in ADNI1/GO/2, then tested again in ADNI3. Models accounted for head size, demographic factors, genetic background and site. Three association approaches were used to examine consistency.

results.zh: 内部线性关联略为负向，外部略为正向，相关系数分别为 −0.028 和 0.011，均接近于零。三类统计分析在两批数据中都未通过校正后的标准，没有支持评分越高、海马越小的预测。
results.en: The internal linear association was slightly negative and the external association slightly positive, with correlations of −0.028 and 0.011, both close to zero. None of the three approaches in either dataset met the corrected criterion, so the predicted higher-score–smaller-hippocampus relationship was not supported.

rationale.zh: 已有随访研究发现，基线内嗅皮层体积与轻度认知障碍（MCI）的后续进展有关（P1）。系统据此提出，把入组时的 MRI 与后来是否、何时出现痴呆联系起来，检验较大体积是否对应较低进展风险。
rationale.en: A previous follow-up study related baseline entorhinal volume to subsequent progression of mild cognitive impairment (MCI) (P1). The system proposed linking MRI at enrollment to whether and when dementia developed, testing whether larger volume corresponds to lower progression risk.

methods.zh: 使用 ADNI1/GO/2 中 MCI 参与者的基线 MRI 和后续随访，研究内嗅皮层大小与 2、3、5 年内痴呆发生时间的关系，再在 ADNI3 重复分析。采用生存分析，考虑头颅大小、年龄、性别、教育及 APOE ε4。
methods.en: Baseline MRI and follow-up from MCI participants in ADNI1/GO/2 were used to study entorhinal size in relation to time to dementia over two, three and five years. The analysis was repeated in ADNI3. Survival models accounted for head size, age, sex, education and APOE ε4.

results.zh: 各随访窗口都呈现体积较大、进展风险较低的方向。内部 5 年分析通过统计校正，风险比为 0.56；外部同一窗口风险比为 0.62，但未通过校正，2 年和 3 年窗口也未通过。因此方向相近，外部支持仍较弱。
results.en: Across follow-up windows, larger volume pointed toward lower progression risk. The internal five-year analysis passed statistical correction, with a hazard ratio of 0.56. The external five-year estimate was 0.62 but did not pass correction, nor did the two- or three-year analyses. Directions were similar, but external support was weaker.

rationale.zh: 对多项脑结构研究的汇总发现，内侧颞叶萎缩是预测阿尔茨海默病进展的一条线索（P1）。系统选择其中与记忆有关的海马，检验基线体积与 MCI 参与者后续痴呆发生时间的关系。
rationale.en: A synthesis of brain-structure studies identified medial temporal atrophy as a clue to Alzheimer's disease progression (P1). The system selected the hippocampus and tested the relationship between its baseline volume and subsequent time to dementia in MCI participants.

methods.zh: 将 ADNI1/GO/2 的基线海马 MRI 与 MCI 随访记录结合，分析海马大小是否与 2、3、5 年内的进展风险有关，再在 ADNI3 中检验。生存模型考虑头颅大小、年龄、性别、教育和 APOE ε4。
methods.en: Baseline hippocampal MRI and MCI follow-up records from ADNI1/GO/2 were combined to examine progression risk over two, three and five years, followed by a test in ADNI3. Survival models accounted for head size, age, sex, education and APOE ε4.

results.zh: 内外部分析均呈现海马较大、风险较低的方向。ADNI3 的 3 年和 5 年分析通过校正，风险比均约为 0.44；内部分析未通过校正，5 年结果最接近标准。因此支持主要出现在外部较长随访中。
results.en: Internal and external analyses both pointed toward lower risk with larger hippocampi. The ADNI3 three- and five-year analyses passed correction, with hazard ratios of about 0.44. Internal analyses did not pass correction, with the five-year result closest to the criterion. Support was concentrated in the longer external follow-up windows.

rationale.zh: 既有纵向 MRI 研究把颞中回萎缩与 MCI 进展联系起来（P1）。系统进一步询问，一次基线 MRI 中的颞中回大小，是否已经包含了后续病程的信息。
rationale.en: Earlier longitudinal MRI research linked middle temporal atrophy to MCI progression (P1). The system asked whether middle temporal size in a single baseline MRI already contains information about subsequent disease course.

methods.zh: 在 ADNI1/GO/2 的 MCI 参与者中，使用基线颞中回体积及随访记录，分析 2、3、5 年内痴呆进展风险，再用 ADNI3 复查。生存模型考虑头颅大小、年龄、性别、教育和 APOE ε4。
methods.en: Baseline middle temporal volume and follow-up records from MCI participants in ADNI1/GO/2 were used to analyze dementia progression over two, three and five years. ADNI3 provided a further check. Survival models accounted for head size, age, sex, education and APOE ε4.

results.zh: 内部 3 年和 5 年分析支持体积较大、风险较低，5 年风险比为 0.39。外部 5 年结果同向（0.52），但未通过校正；外部 2 年虽出现较强信号，进展事件较少，也未达到完整支持要求。各窗口并未形成一致验证。
results.en: The internal three- and five-year analyses supported lower risk with larger volume; the five-year hazard ratio was 0.39. The external five-year result agreed in direction (0.52) but did not pass correction. A stronger external two-year signal involved few progression events and also did not meet the full support criteria. Validation was not consistent across windows.

rationale.zh: 已有研究发现，脑室及脑脊液体积有助于预测认知下降（P1）。系统把这一影像线索用于 MCI 病程，检验基线脑室大小是否与之后进展至痴呆的时间有关。
rationale.en: Previous research found that ventricular and cerebrospinal-fluid volumes helped predict cognitive decline (P1). The system applied this imaging clue to MCI disease course, testing whether baseline ventricular size is related to subsequent time to dementia.

methods.zh: 利用 ADNI1/GO/2 的基线脑室 MRI 测量和 MCI 随访，分析 2、3、5 年内的进展风险，再在 ADNI3 重复。生存分析考虑头颅大小、年龄、性别、教育及 APOE ε4，比较两批数据是否给出相同关系。
methods.en: Baseline ventricular MRI measurements and MCI follow-up from ADNI1/GO/2 were used to analyze progression risk over two, three and five years, followed by replication of the analysis in ADNI3. Survival models accounted for head size, age, sex, education and APOE ε4, allowing comparison of the relationship across datasets.

results.zh: 内部各窗口均未显示明确关联。外部 3 年分析发现脑室较大与较高风险相关，风险比为 2.03；5 年结果未通过校正，2 年结果则受进展事件较少限制。整体上，两批数据未形成一致的病程关联。
results.en: No internal follow-up window showed a clear association. The external three-year analysis linked larger ventricles to higher risk, with a hazard ratio of 2.03. The five-year result did not pass correction, and the two-year result was limited by few progression events. Overall, the datasets did not show a consistent disease-course association.

rationale.zh: 既有研究将全脑体积与海马、脑室及认知指标一起用于预测 MCI 进展（P1）。系统据此单独检验全脑体积这一整体结构指标，询问其与短期及较长期痴呆风险的关系。
rationale.en: Earlier research used whole-brain volume alongside hippocampal, ventricular and cognitive measures to predict MCI progression (P1). The system tested whole-brain volume as a global structural measure, examining its relationship to nearer- and longer-term dementia risk.

methods.zh: 使用 ADNI1/GO/2 的基线全脑 MRI 体积和 MCI 随访记录，分析 2、3、5 年内的痴呆进展，再用 ADNI3 检查结果。模型考虑头颅大小、年龄、性别、教育和 APOE ε4，以比较不同随访时间内的风险关联。
methods.en: Baseline whole-brain MRI volume and MCI follow-up records from ADNI1/GO/2 were used to analyze dementia progression over two, three and five years, followed by an ADNI3 check. Models accounted for head size, age, sex, education and APOE ε4 to compare risk associations across follow-up windows.

results.zh: 5 年窗口中，两批数据都支持全脑体积较大与较低进展风险相关，风险比分别为 0.56 和 0.43，且均通过校正。外部 3 年分析也得到支持；较短随访的结果未在两批数据中一致通过。
results.en: At five years, both datasets supported lower progression risk with larger whole-brain volume. Hazard ratios were 0.56 and 0.43, both passing correction. The external three-year analysis was also supported, while shorter follow-up results did not consistently meet the criteria in both datasets.

rationale.zh: 已有研究将 AD 多基因风险与随时间发生的认知下降联系起来（P1）。系统进一步把结局换成从 MCI 到痴呆的发生时间，检验遗传风险评分能否解释病程快慢。
rationale.en: Earlier research linked AD polygenic risk to cognitive decline over time (P1). The system changed the outcome to time from MCI to dementia, testing whether the genetic-risk score could help explain differences in the pace of progression.

methods.zh: 将 ADNI1/GO/2 中 MCI 参与者的遗传评分与随访记录结合，分析 2、3、5 年内的痴呆发生风险，再在 ADNI3 检验。生存模型考虑年龄、性别、教育及 APOE ε4，比较评分与病程的关联方向。
methods.en: Genetic scores and follow-up records from MCI participants in ADNI1/GO/2 were combined to analyze dementia risk over two, three and five years, followed by testing in ADNI3. Survival models accounted for age, sex, education and APOE ε4 and compared the direction of the score–progression relationship.

results.zh: 所有随访窗口均未通过校正后的统计标准。5 年时，内部风险比为 1.30，外部为 0.95，方向也不一致；本次未支持“遗传风险评分越高，进展越快”的预测。
results.en: No follow-up window passed the corrected statistical criterion. At five years, the internal hazard ratio was 1.30 and the external estimate was 0.95, differing in direction. The experiment did not support the prediction that higher genetic-risk scores correspond to faster progression.

rationale.zh: 文献 P1 发现某个遗传变异与较低的 MCI 进展风险有关。系统将单个变异的线索扩展到孟德尔型 AD 相关基因集合，询问这组基因的累积评分是否与痴呆发生时间相关。
rationale.en: P1 linked a particular genetic variant to lower MCI progression risk. The system extended this single-variant clue to a Mendelian-AD-related gene set, asking whether its aggregate score is associated with time to dementia.

methods.zh: 在 ADNI1/GO/2 中，将孟德尔型 AD 基因集评分与 MCI 后续进展记录进行生存分析，分别考察 2、3、5 年窗口，并在 ADNI3 重复。模型考虑年龄、性别、教育和 APOE ε4。
methods.en: In ADNI1/GO/2, survival analysis related the Mendelian-AD gene-set score to subsequent MCI progression over two-, three- and five-year windows. The analysis was repeated in ADNI3, with models accounting for age, sex, education and APOE ε4.

results.zh: 两批数据的所有随访窗口都未通过校正后的统计标准。5 年风险比分别为 0.86 和 1.13，方向不一致；没有观察到这一基因集评分与病程之间稳定的关联。
results.en: No follow-up window in either dataset passed the corrected statistical criterion. Five-year hazard ratios were 0.86 and 1.13, differing in direction. No stable relationship between this gene-set score and disease course was observed.

rationale.zh: ADHD 研究把默认网络连接与症状维度联系起来，精神分裂症研究也发现默认网络和显著性网络与症状有关（P1、P2）。结合跨诊断额叶连接研究（P3），系统提出检验 ROI312 到默认网络的联系；共同下降是本轮要回答的问题，而非这些文献已经给出的结果。
rationale.en: ADHD research linked default-network connectivity to symptom dimensions, and schizophrenia research related default and salience networks to symptoms (P1, P2). Together with a transdiagnostic study of frontal connectivity (P3), these findings prompted a test of ROI312's connection to the default network. A shared decrease was the question for this experiment, not an established result of those studies.

feedback.zh: 前序测试关注双相障碍和精神分裂症谱系中的 ROI100—默认网络连接，两组都呈下降。本轮改为 ROI312，并把诊断组合换为 ADHD 和精神分裂症谱系，以检验这一线索能否扩展到另一组研究对象。
feedback.en: The earlier test concerned ROI100–default-network connectivity in bipolar disorder and the schizophrenia spectrum, with decreases in both groups. This round moved to ROI312 and changed the combination to ADHD and the schizophrenia spectrum to test the clue in another diagnostic pairing.

methods.zh: 使用 TCP 静息态脑成像，测量右侧 ROI312 与默认网络的平均连接，分别比较 ADHD、精神分裂症谱系患者与对照，并考虑年龄、性别和站点。UCLA 用于复查两类诊断，COBRE、HCP-EP 用于补充精神病性障碍比较，另检查头动影响。
methods.en: Using TCP resting-state imaging, the analysis measured mean connectivity between right ROI312 and the default network, comparing ADHD and schizophrenia-spectrum groups with controls while accounting for age, sex and site. UCLA provided both diagnostic checks, COBRE and HCP-EP added psychosis comparisons, and head motion was also examined.

results.zh: TCP 和 UCLA 中两组均呈连接下降，共同下降的重复抽样比例分别为 80.5% 和 91.0%。另外两个队列的精神病性障碍结果也呈下降；其中 ADHD 的外部变化较小，是两组共同模式中较弱的一环。
results.en: Both groups showed lower connectivity in TCP and UCLA, with joint decreases in 80.5% and 91.0% of resamples. Psychosis results in the other two cohorts also showed decreases. The external ADHD effect was smaller and was the weaker part of the shared pattern.
